scope: Historical reference triage; not current qualification, full investigation, financial advice, or publication approval.
fresh_discovery: Separate; no admission or current verification is implied.
recommendation_reason: Specific Base token identifier and event-linked chain reference; strongest fit for token-oriented historical reader replay in this bounded set. This is a liquidity case, not a proven sell trap.
method: No model calls, paid sources, wallet transactions, or direct RPC. Source pages were read where accessible; blocked explorer links remain unverified leads.

cases.name: SQUID (Squid Game token)

identifier.verification: source-linked or source-reported; no independent RPC decoding

cases.historical_mechanism: Reported selective selling restrictions and changeable proxy logic; analyst observed some successful sells, and SharkTeam traced token cash-outs into BNB.
cases.attributed_claim: Historical investigator claims; not proof that every holder was unable to sell.
uncertainties: Historical implementations and exact holder-level behavior have not been independently replayed.
The 2026 article reports a later proxy state, not the November 2021 state.
